differentiators.title: Advanced Diagnostic Imaging

differentiators.title: Stress-Free Environment
differentiators.description: Our office is specifically designed to be calm, modern, and efficient to reduce the anxiety often associated with dental visits.

differentiators.title: Comprehensive Savings Plan

treatmentJourney.title: Diagnostic Imaging & CBCT
treatmentJourney.description: We begin with a thorough exam using digital X-rays and Cone Beam CT imaging to visualize the complex root anatomy and diagnose the infection.

treatmentJourney.title: Anesthesia & Isolation
treatmentJourney.description: The tooth is completely numbed for your comfort and isolated with a rubber dam to maintain a sterile environment for the procedure.

treatmentJourney.title: Microscope-Guided Cleaning
treatmentJourney.description: Using advanced magnification, we carefully remove the infected pulp and disinfect every intricate canal within the root system.

treatmentJourney.title: Precise Canal Sealing
treatmentJourney.description: Once thoroughly cleaned, the canals are filled and sealed with biocompatible material to prevent any future bacterial reinfection.

treatmentJourney.title: Temporary Restoration
treatmentJourney.description: A temporary filling is placed to protect the tooth while it heals, ensuring you can function normally until your final restoration is ready.

treatmentJourney.title: Healing & Final Crown
treatmentJourney.description: After confirming the infection is resolved, a permanent crown is placed to restore the tooth's full strength and natural appearance.

benefits.title: Modern Microscope Tech
benefits.description: Our practice utilizes advanced technology like Cone Beam CT imaging and digital X-rays to ensure precise and efficient root canal treatments.

benefits.title: Compassionate Comfort
benefits.description: We prioritize your comfort with a patient-centered approach designed to minimize discomfort and provide a relaxing environment during dental procedures.

benefits.title: Honest Treatment Plans
benefits.description: Our mission is to provide thorough and upfront information about your treatment options and costs, ensuring there are no surprises during your care.

benefits.title: Flexible Financing
benefits.description: Access the care you need through major insurance carriers or convenient monthly payment plans via CareCredit, Cherry, and Sunbit.

benefits.title: In-House Savings Plan
benefits.description: Patients without insurance can benefit from our Dental Savings Plan, offering routine cleanings and significant discounts on major procedures.

benefits.title: Same-Day Emergencies
benefits.description: We provide same-day emergency dental care for patients in pain, ensuring quick relief for toothaches or infections when you need it most.

implantOptions.title: Root Canal Therapy
implantOptions.description: Advanced removal of infected pulp using precise imaging and cleaning techniques to save your natural tooth and eliminate chronic pain.

implantOptions.title: Emergency Endodontics
implantOptions.description: Immediate care for severe toothaches, abscesses, or trauma to prevent tooth loss and stop the spread of infection.

implantOptions.title: Cracked Tooth Diagnosis
implantOptions.description: Utilizing high-tech intra-oral cameras and digital X-rays to identify and treat hairline fractures before they require extraction.

implantOptions.title: Dental Crowns
implantOptions.description: Durable, natural-looking restorations placed after root canal therapy to protect and strengthen the treated tooth for years to come.

faqItems.question: Do root canals really hurt anymore?
faqItems.answer: At Aqua Dental, your comfort is our priority. We use modern anesthesia and advanced techniques to minimize discomfort and make the process feel similar to a standard filling.

faqItems.question: Are you accepting new patients?
faqItems.answer: Yes, Aqua Dental is currently accepting new patients from White Lake, Waterford, Commerce Township, and surrounding areas for root canals and general care.

faqItems.question: What happens if I don't get the root canal?
faqItems.answer: Ignoring an infected tooth can lead to the spread of infection, severe pain, and eventually the loss of the tooth, necessitating more expensive replacements.

faqItems.question: Will I need a crown after my root canal?
faqItems.answer: Most root-canal-treated teeth require a crown to restore strength and protect the tooth from future fractures, ensuring long-term success.

faqItems.question: Do you accept my dental insurance?
faqItems.answer: We accept most major insurance carriers and offer flexible financing through CareCredit and Sunbit to help make your treatment affordable.

faqItems.question: What technology do you use for diagnosis?
faqItems.answer: We use Cone Beam CT (CBCT) Imaging and Digital X-rays to get a precise, 3D understanding of your root anatomy before we ever begin treatment.

doctor.name: Zaid Hadi
doctor.bio: Dr. Zaid Hadi is a skilled and experienced endodontist dedicated to providing his patients with the highest quality of root canal therapy. He received his Bachelor of Dental Surgery degree and completed a general practice residency before pursuing advanced specialist training in the United States. Dr. Hadi combines his technical expertise with a patient-centered approach to ensure every procedure is comfortable and effective. He remains committed to modern, evidence-based care.

reviews.name: MichiganTodd
reviews.text: For dentistry - I promise you will say that after one visit to AquaDental. This place is 5 star clean. The tech is absolutely up to date and the doctors and staff stand out.

reviews.text: I had an excellent experience from beginning to end. The hygienist was amazing — very gentle, thorough, and professional. I highly recommend Aqua Dental!

reviews.name: Taylor Trammell
reviews.text: Such an amazing experience. Dr. Alani was thorough and very thoughtful when explaining my care plan. Every part of my experience exceeded my expectations.

reviews.name: Sarah M.
reviews.text: I was so nervous about my root canal, but the technology here is incredible. They showed me the 3D scans and the whole process was completely painless.
